offers_products.reason: Makes and sells packaged shelf-stable foods under 50+ brands such as Green Giant, Ortega, Crisco, Cream of Wheat.

offers_services.reason: Sells branded packaged foods only; no customer services are among its main offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer food brands sold through grocery stores; shoppers choose the brands for their families.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to grocery retailers, mass merchants, club stores and foodservice customers who buy for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of packaged pantry foods by retailers and shoppers drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Staple packaged groceries are bought regularly, and demand holds up in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased grocery items such as canned vegetables, spices and baking products.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured packaged food goods, not staff time or skill.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households, and retailers resell to them; the consumer-brand model leans toward no.

asset_heavy.reason: Brand-acquisition model with food manufacturing plants and co-packers; it is less capital-intensive than heavy manufacturing.

notes: Large retailer customers like Walmart are significant, so large_customers and asset_heavy are judgment calls.
